title: Bug: Missing admin_status in CONFIG_DB for interfaces not part of sonic-mgmt topology
author: rminnikanti
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

When deploying the minigraph using sonic-mgmt scripts, the minigraph command sets the "admin_status" to "up" only for interfaces that are part of the defined topology. Interfaces not included in the topology are left without an "admin_status" field in the configuration.

This omission causes components like buffermgrd to indefinitely wait for the "admin_status" field. During test execution, if sonic-mgmt test cases attempt to shut down interfaces that are not part of the topology, the "admin_status" for those interfaces is then added to CONFIG_DB. As a result, buffermgrd, which had been waiting for this field, immediately applies buffer profile updates to the interface. This unexpected behavior can lead to test case failures, particularly those involving checkpoint validations.

config load_minigraph --override_config -y

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Create a checkpoint of the configuration
```
config checkpoint test
```
2.  Apply Ethernet0 admin status down
```
cat eth_admin_patch.json
[
    {
        "op": "add",
        "path": "/PORT/Ethernet0/admin_status",
        "value": "down"
    }
]
```
3. apply patch
```
config apply-patch eth_admin_patch.json
```
4. Rollback the configuration.
```
config rollback test
```

**Related PTF test cases:**
generic_config_updater/test_eth_interface.py::test_eth_interface_admin_change

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

config rollback test command is expected to succeed and 
Below PTF test case is expected to succeed
```
generic_config_updater/test_eth_interface.py::test_eth_interface_admin_change
```

linkedPullRequests.title: [buffermgrd]: Set admin_status down to ports with no admin_status
linkedPullRequests.author: rminnikanti
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22931
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23354 

**Why I did it:**
config_db producers like minigraph doesn't always set admin_status down for ports as admin_status default value is down.

This causes doSpeedUpdateTask() logic wait indefinitely for admin_status on ports.

During test execution, if sonic-mgmt test cases attempt to shut down interfaces that are not part of the topology, the "admin_status" for those interfaces is then added to CONFIG_DB. As a result, buffermgrd, which had been waiting for this field, immediately applies buffer profile updates to the interface. This unexpected behavior can lead to test case failures, particularly those involving checkpoint validations.

**How I did it**
Set admin_status down to ports with no admin_status

**How to verify it**
Run below testcase on T0 topology:
generic_config_updater/test_eth_interface.py::test_eth_interface_admin_change[down]

**Which release branch to backport (provide reason below if selected)**
* [ ]  202205
* [ ]  202211
* [ ]  202305
* [ ]  202311
* [ ]  202405
* [x]  202411
* [x]  202505

Tested branch (Please provide the tested image version)

**Description for the changelog**
